$comment: A handoff draft: what you write, before `teamctl handoff publish --handoff <this>` turns it into a record. The ledger fills in handoffId, seq, from, publishedAt, publishedBy and handoffDigest; setting any of them here is refused rather than overridden. inputSnapshotDigest and taskFrozenDigest are also filled in from the task, but you may declare either as an assertion about the task world you worked in, and publication is refused if it has moved since. Declare them when the work took a while: the two move independently, so a task reissued with the same inputs and a new writeSet moves only the second. See schemas/handoff.schema.json for the stored shape and templates/handoff.md for the same content as prose.
summary: Coupon discount is applied once per order, enforced in the domain layer rather than at the API edge so batch imports go through the same rule. Stacking with promo codes is rejected with 409.
unresolved: Whether an expired coupon on a saved cart should fail the checkout or silently drop; the contract does not say.
